title: Suggest: Provael — adversarial evaluation for VLA robot policies
body:
### Resource Name

Provael

### URL

https://www.provael.com

### GitHub Repository

provael/provael

### Alternative Repository

_No response_

### Category

Dynamics Simulation

### Description

Model-agnostic red-teaming for open Vision-Language-Action robot policies in simulation. Runs attack families against a policy and reports the Attack Success Rate alongside a matched benign control arm on the identical task suite. Includes the Embodied AI Security Top 10 taxonomy and a signed leaderboard. Apache-2.0, pip install, Docker image, runs on CPU.

### Why should it be included?

Fills a gap rather than adding to a crowded category. The list covers simulation, planning, control, perception, and dynamics. It has no entry for adversarially evaluating a learned policy, which is a distinct problem: the model output is the actuator command, so a wrong interpretation becomes a physical boundary violation rather than an incorrect prediction.

The design decision that makes it useful to this audience is the control arm. Every attack result is reported beside the rate the same policy produces on the identical task suite with nothing applied. Most published embodied attack results omit that, which makes them uninterpretable.

Honest scope, stated up front: all results are simulation; there is no real-hardware result yet, and the repository says so on its front page. Three
attack families move the violation rate less than the benign arm's own variance and ship as published nulls.

Disclosure: I maintain it.

### Must-have checklist (all required)

- [ ] Relevant to robotics (simulation, planning, perception, control, dynamics, etc.)
- [ ] Publicly accessible (open source, or well-documented commercial tool)
- [ ] Not a duplicate of an existing entry
- [ ] Has a meaningful description

### Scoring checklist (need ≥ 3 of 5)

- [ ] **Popularity**: ≥ 50 GitHub stars (or equivalent community adoption for non-GitHub projects)
- [x] **Activity**: At least one commit within the last 2 years
- [x] **Documentation**: Has a README with usage examples or API docs
- [ ] **Maturity**: Project is ≥ 6 months old
- [x] **Uniqueness**: Fills a niche not already covered by existing entries
